notes: Line numbers are as of the base commit. `random` names the seeded stream a formula draws on, or null when it is deterministic.
`placement` says where the formula runs: authoring (a generator writes rows), kill, swing, settle, tick, press (a player intent), envelope (every state projection), display.
`status` on a formula: live, staged, unbuilt (ruled or designed, no code), dead (code with no caller on the hunt path).
Exception classes: 1 foundational mechanic, 2 content parameter (move to data), 3 intentional special mechanic (needs Tyler's explicit approval), 4 accidental complexity (eliminate).
A later guard can refuse any new exception whose class is 4, and any new formula whose `impl` has more than one authoring site without a `twinGuard`.
